creator: forcceee_
title: Four 'must-install' Claude Code plugins for vibe coding: Ponytail (token cut), OmniRoute (free-provider fallback), Graphify (codebase knowledge graph), Agentscribe 24-skill pack

tools.name: Ponytail
tools.detail: On-screen: /plugin marketplace add DietrichGebert/ponytail then /plugin install ponytail@ponytail; claims >50% token cut with no accuracy loss

tools.name: OmniRoute
tools.detail: Router across 300+ free AI providers; auto-switches when usage limit hits; 'up to 1.6B free tokens/month'; on-screen Free-Tier Budget 1.4B / 1.6B with Kiro, Qoder rows

tools.name: Graphify
tools.detail: Turns codebase into a knowledge graph so the agent stops rereading files; demoed inside a 'DevSwarm' IDE with 'graphify' command and 'Install graphify and resolve Python interpreter'

tools.name: Agentscribe / 'Agent Skills' (24 skills)
tools.detail: Pack of 24 skills 'by the former AI engineering director at Google'; dedicated planning/coding/testing/publishing skills auto-activated by stage; on-screen pills Spec / Plan / Build

claims: Ponytail cuts token usage by over 50% without losing any accuracy
OmniRoute connects to over 300 free AI providers and gives up to 1.6 billion free tokens every month, auto-switching when a limit is hit
Graphify builds a knowledge graph of the whole codebase so the agent does not waste tokens rereading files
Agentscribe is 24 skills built by a former Google AI engineering director and activates the right one by coding stage on its own
how_to_steps: Add the Ponytail marketplace and install the plugin (/plugin marketplace add DietrichGebert/ponytail; /plugin install ponytail@ponytail)
Set up OmniRoute as a fallback router so Claude Code switches to free providers when the subscription limit is reached
Install Graphify and run it on the repo to build the knowledge graph before coding
Install the 24-skill Agentscribe pack and let it pick planning/coding/testing/publishing skills by stage

relevance.why: Haji already uses Claude Code on a subscription; Ponytail and Graphify could cut token burn and context waste, but this is a scripted roundup (same script reused by ai.honeycove) with no demo of results.

implement_score.why: Ponytail install is two slash commands and already endorsed in the liked set; Graphify is the only genuinely new candidate (try on one repo, ~1 hour). OmniRoute fallback to random free providers is a quality/security risk for production app code; the 24-skill pack is unverified.

verify: Ponytail: does DietrichGebert/ponytail exist and is the >50% figure measured or marketing? (liked set's caveman fact-check found ~30% for a similar skill)
OmniRoute: what are the 300 'free' providers, what are their data-retention terms, and does routing app code through them leak IP?
Graphify: exact repo, does it support Claude Code hooks, and does graph build time pay for itself on a small app repo?
Agentscribe: who is the 'former AI engineering director at Google', repo name, and are the 24 skills maintained? The transcript name differs across uploads ('agentscribe' vs 'agent skills')
This exact script appears verbatim on ai.honeycove (7683640993203113229): likely a paid/templated script, so treat claims as copy, not testing

gap.what: Liked set covers Ponytail and OmniRoute; new items are Graphify (codebase knowledge graph to cut rereads) and the 24-skill Agentscribe pack with stage-based auto-activation, plus the exact Ponytail install commands.
